	Must possess suggestive selling skills

	Experience in the hospitality industry could be an added advantage but not compulsory

Restaurant Cashier & Cook Job at the Place - Smackers Limited




        
    

        
        The Place - We are a fast growing, world class, and dynamic, multi-billion Nigerian conglomerates, established and managed by a team of professionals with decades of management consulting and accounting experience/ training from Arthur Andersen (now KPMG in Nigeria). We are a profitable player in the QSR sector of the Hospitality industry in Nigeria with great prospects and staff strength of over 1000 employees. Currently, our operations span across 17 locations in Lagos and Abuja, Nigeria, with rapid expansion plans to penetrate more locations in the short to medium term.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Restaurant Cashier & Cook
     

            
    



Job Location: Itire, Surulere - Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are currently looking for versatile, intelligent and energetic restaurant cashiersand cooks with passion for delivering outstanding service to join our professional and friendly team.
	This person will be responsible for providing passionate, charming and attentive service delivery to all customers according to our service standards in order to ensure guest satisfaction.


Job Summary


	As the Restaurant Cashier, you will work alongside team members in ensuring customers have a wonderful experience, deliver quality service and maintaining relationships with customers.


Key Responsibilities


	Ensures customers are attended to in a courteous and friendly manner and swift resolution is given to their issues/complaints
	Ensures sales entries are correctly entered and receipts are issued to customer
	Maintain excellent level of hygiene at all the time
	Must be knowledgeable about the company products
	Must possess suggestive selling skills


Qualifications


	Minimum of SSCE
	Maximum of OND
	Experience in the hospitality industry could be an added advantage but not compulsory
	Must be between 18-25 years old
	Must be able to work in a team environment
	Must reside in or be able to work in Itire, Surulere.


Note: Candidates who do not meet the above criteria need not apply

Job Summary


	Our client is seeking for a dynamic Senior Insurance Broking Marketer to join their team
	In this role, you&#39;ll lead strategic marketing initiatives, partner with senior management and cross-functional teams, and drive growth, brand visibility, and business development across the insurance broking space.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead the creation and execution of marketing strategies to promote insurance broking services and grow the client base.
	Oversee and enhance the company&#39;s brand identity across all channels, ensuring consistent messaging and positioning in line with the business goals.
	Conduct in-depth market research to identify industry trends, customer needs, and competitor strategies, providing actionable insights to influence marketing plans.
	Develop and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns (including digital, print, events, and direct marketing) to generate leads, increase customer engagement, and strengthen relationships.
	Create compelling content (e.g., brochures, case studies, website copy, newsletters, blog posts) that resonates with target audiences and drives business objectives.
	Work closely with brokers and account managers to create customer-focused marketing materials and communication strategies that drive retention and satisfaction.
	Develop targeted campaigns for lead generation, utilizing digital marketing tools and social media, while ensuring a strong pipeline of qualified prospects.
	Cultivate relationships with key industry stakeholders, including insurers, brokers, and partners, to enhance brand visibility and foster collaboration opportunities.

	Lead and mentor junior marketing staff while collaborating with cross-functional teams including sales, operations, and product development.

	A Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.
	5 - 7 years in marketing, including 3+ years in a senior role within insurance or financial services.
	Solid grasp of the insurance broking markets, trends, regulations, and client expectations.

	Strong digital marketing skills &mdash; SEO, SEM, social media, marketing automation.
	Sharp analytical ability paired with creative, strategic thinking.
	Excellent communication and project management skills.
	A self-motivated, results-driven, customer-centric mindset.
	Ability to analyze data and generate actionable insights to drive marketing effectiveness.
	Creative and strategic thinking with the ability to innovate and solve problems.


Salary
N400,000 - N500,000 / Month.&nbsp;

Method of Application

Senior Insurance Broking Marketer Job at Refine Concepts




        
    

        
        Refine Concepts - Our client is a professional insurance broking company dedicated to helping clients manage risk through tailored insurance solutions and expert advisory.

They are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Senior Insurance Broking Marketer

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Our client is seeking for a dynamic Senior Insurance Broking Marketer to join their team
	In this role, you'll lead strategic marketing initiatives, partner with senior management and cross-functional teams, and drive growth, brand visibility, and business development across the insurance broking space.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead the creation and execution of marketing strategies to promote insurance broking services and grow the client base.
	Oversee and enhance the company's brand identity across all channels, ensuring consistent messaging and positioning in line with the business goals.
	Conduct in-depth market research to identify industry trends, customer needs, and competitor strategies, providing actionable insights to influence marketing plans.
	Develop and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns (including digital, print, events, and direct marketing) to generate leads, increase customer engagement, and strengthen relationships.
	Create compelling content (e.g., brochures, case studies, website copy, newsletters, blog posts) that resonates with target audiences and drives business objectives.
	Work closely with brokers and account managers to create customer-focused marketing materials and communication strategies that drive retention and satisfaction.
	Develop targeted campaigns for lead generation, utilizing digital marketing tools and social media, while ensuring a strong pipeline of qualified prospects.
	Cultivate relationships with key industry stakeholders, including insurers, brokers, and partners, to enhance brand visibility and foster collaboration opportunities.
	Track, measure, and report on the performance of marketing campaigns, using data and analytics to assess ROI and optimize future strategies.
	Lead and mentor junior marketing staff while collaborating with cross-functional teams including sales, operations, and product development.


Requirements


	A Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.
	5 - 7 years in marketing, including 3+ years in a senior role within insurance or financial services.
	Solid grasp of the insurance broking markets, trends, regulations, and client expectations.


Skills:


	Strong digital marketing skills — SEO, SEM, social media, marketing automation.
	Sharp analytical ability paired with creative, strategic thinking.
	Excellent communication and project management skills.
	A self-motivated, results-driven, customer-centric mindset.
	Ability to analyze data and generate actionable insights to drive marketing effectiveness.
	Creative and strategic thinking with the ability to innovate and solve problems.


Salary
N400,000 - N500,000 / Month. 

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

They are used to recover various types of renewable resources, reduce environmental pollution, and promote the industrial development of Nigeria. Recycling Ant has opened a franchise model in Lagos. If you are interested in becoming our partner, please don&#39;t hesitate to contact us!

Ant Express has an advanced logistics system and can provide customers with professional services. Real-time control of the latest status in each transportation process of items, and excellent delivery, transit and transportation of items. With the combination of manpower and technology, the goods are guaranteed to be in good condition and delivered in time

Antshop Online is an E-Commerce and online Shopping destination.We pride ourselves in having everything you could possibly need for life and living at the best prices than anywhere else.
